Nyimbo Cia Agendi — Privacy Policy
Last updated: 10 November 2026

This first release works offline. It does not collect, transmit, or share personal or device data. It has no account, advertising, analytics, push notifications, or online sync.

Songs are bundled with the app. Favorites, appearance choices, and reading history are stored only in Android’s private app storage on your device. They are not sent to a server and are removed when you clear the app’s data or uninstall it.

If you choose Share, Android opens the share sheet and sends only the app’s title and description to the destination you select. Nyimbo Cia Agendi does not receive that information back.

For privacy questions, contact the developer using the contact email shown on this app’s Google Play listing.
